featured.title: Madhu Guru · Meta AI 高级总监，前 Google Gemini/Veo/Nano Banana 负责人
featured.summaryEn: Meta Senior Director of AI Madhu Guru, who previously led Gemini, Veo, and Nano Banana at Google, published part 7 of his evals series on what he calls the Goldilocks principle: measure at the level of the jobs to be done, not just the final answer. His example is a financial analysis agent whose ultimate output is a stock recommendation. The most common mistake is building a golden set of right answers and checking whether the agent picked the "right" stock — when in fact several meaningful jobs happened first: u…
featured.insightZh: Meta AI 高级总监、前 Google Gemini / Veo / Nano Banana 负责人 Madhu Guru 的 eval 系列写到第七篇，主题是「金发姑娘原则」：你的 eval 应该按「要完成的各个 job」分层去量，而不是只盯最终答案。他举了个金融分析 agent 的例子——最终输出是一个选股建议，最常见的错误做法是准备一套标准答案，然后检查 agent 有没有推荐「对的」股票。问题在于，得出这个建议之前发生了一堆有意义的中间环节：理解客户（组合、风险偏好、投资周期、目标、约束）、收集证据（各只股票和板块的最新数据、宏观环境、Fed 政策、近期和即将发生的新闻）、分析数据（营收增长、估值指引、增长预测，收敛出少量候选）、最后才是给建议（股票代码、买卖价格、时间窗口）。每一个环节都产出中间结果，每一个都可以、也应该有自己的 eval。这样当最终建议错了，一份设计良好的 eval 集会告诉你：客户理解 92%、证据抽取 92%、数据分析 70%、建议 75%——你立刻知道该去哪儿刨。而且你可能会意识到数据分析这一步太复杂，需要再拆成更细的 job 并各自建 eval。不要太细，也不要太粗，刚刚好：eval…

featured.title: Guillermo Rauch · Vercel CEO
featured.summaryEn: Vercel CEO Guillermo Rauch made two points this week. First, intelligence is getting cheaper: OpenAI Sol's price reductions and discounts on Vercel AI Gateway have made Sol their fastest-growing frontier model. He reads two lessons into that — demand for intelligence is highly elastic, so usage grows rapidly as inference costs fall; and if you're not using a gateway you're missing out on price volatility that lowers operating costs and raises margins. "It's no wonder the router space has heated up… gateways are in…
featured.insightZh: Vercel CEO Guillermo Rauch 这周抛了两个观点。第一个关于「智能正在变便宜」：OpenAI Sol 的降价和 Vercel AI Gateway 上的折扣，让 Sol 成了他们增长最快的前沿模型。他从中读出两件事——① 对智能的需求是高度弹性的，推理成本一降，用量就迅速涨上去；② 如果你没在用 gateway，就等于放弃了这波价格波动带来的红利，而这直接影响你的运营成本和毛利。他的结论是 router 赛道打得这么热并不奇怪，gateway 是必然的。第二个是 fx 的扩展哲学：走开放协议——MCP（modelcontextprotocol.io）、Skills（agentskills.io）、Plugins（agent-plugins.org），以及最好的那个协议 Unix：小程序各做好一件事、靠互相调用来组合；配上 libfx 让它能被嵌进更复杂的程序，你应该可以自己搭 CLI、后台 agent、software factory，本地或云端都行。

items.title: Peter Yang · AI 教程与访谈创作者
items.summaryEn: AI tutorials and interviews creator Peter Yang relayed a useful distinction from Shreya Shankar: there are two types of AI evals, top-down and bottom-up. "Think of top-down as: If you're in a vacuum, just given the task description, what would you come up with? Claude does a very good job of helping you with these top-down evals. Bottom-up evals are the other half. When you look at lots and lots of sample outputs, what is your gut feedback that you want externalized into evals? Claude is very, very bad at coming u…
items.insightZh: AI 教程与访谈创作者 Peter Yang 转述了 Shreya Shankar 关于 eval 的一个分法：eval 分自上而下和自下而上两种。「自上而下可以这么理解：如果你身处真空，手上只有一份任务描述，你会想出什么？在这类 top-down eval 上 Claude 帮得上大忙。」而自下而上是另一半——当你看过大量样本输出之后，你想把哪些直觉反馈外化成 eval？「Claude 在构造 bottom-up eval 上非常、非常差。那部分全得靠你自己。」他同时推荐了 Shreya 和 Hamel 的 AI evals 课程，在 Maven 上有 900 条评价、4.7 分，下一期 9 月 5 日开课。

items.title: Garry Tan · Y Combinator 总裁兼 CEO
items.summaryEn: Y Combinator President and CEO Garry Tan offered a short but sharp prediction: "systems of record will need to become AI harnesses or face replacement by agents." For anyone building SaaS or enterprise software, the implication is that the moat of simply storing data and rendering a UI for humans is eroding — value moves to being the layer where agents can reliably operate on your data.
items.insightZh: Y Combinator 总裁兼 CEO Garry Tan 给了一个很短但很硬的预测：记录系统（systems of record）要么把自己变成 AI harness，要么被 agent 取代。对做 SaaS 和企业软件的人来说，这句话的含义是——单纯「存数据 + 给人看界面」的护城河正在失效，价值要转移到「能让 agent 在你的数据上可靠地跑起来」这一层。

items.title: Thibault Sottiaux · OpenAI，负责 Codex 与 ChatGPT
items.summaryEn: Thibault Sottiaux, who works on Codex and ChatGPT at OpenAI, did two things this week. He kept communicating publicly about usage limits: the reset has been propagated to accounts and fixes landed for the usage issues flagged the day before, with more to come. And he offered a call worth noting: "2026 is the year companies start seriously caring about model efficiency and reliability as it becomes critical infrastructure."
items.insightZh: OpenAI 负责 Codex 与 ChatGPT 的 Thibault Sottiaux 这周做了两件事。一是就用量问题持续对外沟通：额度重置已经推送到各账号，前一天提到的用量相关问题也修了一批，用户应该能感觉到正面变化，后续还会继续跟进和通报。二是一句判断：2026 会是企业开始认真在意模型效率和可靠性的一年——因为模型正在变成关键基础设施。

items.title: Peter Steinberger · OpenClaw 与 OpenAI
items.summaryEn: Peter Steinberger, working on OpenClaw and at OpenAI, made a simple point this week: "cli is nice, having UI visualizations and your team where you work is nicer." He also shipped something hands-on — adding a rotation USB protocol so he could tell his claw to look around, and it's now having fun with his 360 webcam.
items.insightZh: OpenClaw 和 OpenAI 的 Peter Steinberger 这周的观点是：CLI 挺好，但把可视化 UI 和你的团队放在你实际办公的地方，更好。他同时晒了个动手成果——给设备加上了旋转 USB 协议支持，然后让他的 claw 自己「四处看看」，现在它正拿着一个 360 度摄像头玩得不亦乐乎。

items.title: Building intelligent apps for Apple platforms with Claude in the Foundation Models framework
items.summaryEn: Anthropic released Foundation Models framework support for Claude through a new Swift package, letting Apple developers hand off from Apple's on-device models to Claude for heavier work. Apple's framework already returns typed Swift values through guided generation in as few as three lines of code, which is great for fast local tasks like summarization or extraction. The new package lets developers call Claude "when a request calls for multi-step reasoning, code generation, and more," with web search for current information and code execution for data analysis, streaming back into the same view. The engineering win: because Apple's framework returns typed values from @Generable annotations, "developers arrive at the Claude API call with clean inputs instead of raw user text." Concretely, a journaling app can generate daily prompts on-device then ask Claude to find threads across months…
items.insightZh: Anthropic 发布了一个新的 Swift package，让 Apple 开发者可以在 Apple 的 Foundation Models framework 里直接调用 Claude。Apple 这套框架本来的定位是让开发者从 Swift 原生调用模型，通过 guided generation 返回带类型的 Swift 值，最少三行代码就能跑起来，适合摘要、抽取这类快速的端侧任务。现在的新增能力是：当请求需要多步推理、代码生成等更重的活儿时，可以直接交棒给 Claude，Claude 还能联网搜最新信息、执行代码做数据分析，响应流式回到同一个 view。一个关键的工程细节是——因为 Apple 的框架通过 @Generable 注解返回带类型的 Swift 值，开发者到调用 Claude API 这一步拿到的是干净的结构化输入，而不是原始用户文本。落地形态很直观：日记类 app 可以在端侧生成每日 prompt，再让 Claude 去跨几个月的条目里找线索；学习类 app 可以在端侧解释一个术语，学生追问「这为什么跟我们学过的其他内容有关」时再交给 Claude。对用户是一段体验，背后每一步用最合适的模型。支持从明天起可用，覆盖 iOS 27、iPadOS 27、macOS 27、visionOS 27 和 watchOS 27；加进项目、用 Anthropic API key 登录即可，package 会处理 streaming、tool call 和结构化响应回传到 SwiftUI view。
